name: Evil Snake 57
author: MikeAndrewDesigner
description: Gradient dark violet button that starts animating on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background changes from -webkit-linear-gradient(#B563FF, #535EFC, #0EC8EE) to linear-gradient(144deg, #1e1e1e , 20%,#1e1e1e 50%,#1e1e1e ), text color changes from #fff to #fff, top becomes -70%.
